blockers.text: Kalshi official results are stored in the private vault on the Phase 10 directive. The 2026-11-13 rights audit reads Kalshi's terms as limiting storage to facilitating the owner's own trading; confirm that reading or obtain written authorisation.
MLB Stats API and ESPN-derived data are tier UNRESOLVED_INTERNAL_ONLY: private internal research only until terms are cleared.
The CFBD raw cache is still on a public branch (cfb-edge-finder research-data). It is now preserved privately, so the public copy can be removed without losing reproducibility.
Sessions cannot create GitHub release assets, so the vault uses <=45 MB git parts and pins nflverse play-by-play 1999-2009 by hash instead of storing it.
Unreachable from sessions: api.collegefootballdata.com, api.nhle.com (stats), cdn.nba.com, moneypuck.com, baseballsavant.mlb.com, retrosheet.org.

The NBA 2H fix changes 2H pricing; the frozen preseason baseline digest was kept by pinning the settlement engine version. Decide: mint a new baseline or accept the pin (nba-edge-finder draft PR #108).

notice: Agent-run, not human verified. Every number is read from committed evidence files. No model trained, promoted or activated; no trading change.

official_settlements.note: Official results as served by Kalshi's public API (/historical/markets before the settlement cutoff, /markets?status=settled after). Counts only here; rows are in the private vault. Official outcome, our computed settlement and box-score truth are separate layers and are never merged. Classes: value_settled = numeric/score expiration value; admin_literal_untraded = literal Yes/No value on a zero-volume market (administrative); fair_price_settlement = settled between 0 and 1.
